ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a bracketed transition-state structure, and curved arrows are required to be ignored. The main body is a six-membered carbon ring; at the top of the ring there is an exocyclic methylene-like double bond, that is, the top ring carbon forms C=C with the outer terminal carbon. The chiral carbon at the upper left of the ring is connected through a dashed bond to an N=C=S isothiocyanate substituent. An intraring C=C double bond is visible at the lower left side of the ring. Two adjacent chiral carbons on the right side of the ring each bear an OH, and both OH are drawn with solid wedge bonds. Reasoning conversion: According to the specified traversal, start from the exocyclic methylene, the terminal carbon is double-bonded to the top ring carbon and opens the ring numbering, written as C=C1. Continue to the chiral ring carbon bearing the dashed N=C=S substituent; according to this traversal direction, its configuration is written as [C@H](N=C=S). Then proceed along the ring through the intraring double-bond segment in the figure, written as C=C. Then continue to the two adjacent hydroxyl-bearing chiral centers on the right/lower right; according to the wedge direction and current traversal, they are written respectively as [C@@H](O)[C@H]1O, and use 1 to close back to the top ring carbon. Combining gives SMILES: C=C1[C@H](N=C=S)C=C[C@@H](O)[C@H]1O.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure, then convert it atom-by-atom. Choose a traversal beginning at the exocyclic methylene, giving C=C1 for the methylene double-bonded to the top ring carbon. Continue around the ring through the chiral carbon bearing the dashed N=C=S substituent, encode it as [C@H](N=C=S), then include the ring double bond segment C=C. Continue to the two adjacent hydroxyl-bearing stereocenters on the right/lower-right, assigning the wedge stereochemistry consistently with the traversal as [C@@H](O)[C@H]1O. Combining these pieces yields C=C1[C@H](N=C=S)C=C[C@@H](O)[C@H]1O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个带括号的过渡态结构，要求忽略弯箭头。主体是六元碳环；环顶部有一个外消旋/外环亚甲基样的双键，即顶端环碳与外侧末端碳形成 C=C。环左上方的手性碳通过虚线键连接到 N=C=S 异硫氰酸酯取代基。环左下侧可见一个环内 C=C 双键。环右侧相邻两个手性碳各带一个 OH，两个 OH 都以实楔键画出。推理转换：按指定遍历从外环亚甲基开始，末端碳双键连接到顶端环碳并开启环编号，写作 C=C1。继续到带虚线 N=C=S 取代基的手性环碳，按该遍历方向其构型写为 [C@H](N=C=S)。接着沿环经过图中的环内双键片段，写作 C=C。再继续到右侧/右下方两个相邻带羟基的手性中心，按楔线方向和当前遍历分别写作 [C@@H](O)[C@H]1O，并用 1 闭合回顶端环碳。合并得到 SMILES：C=C1[C@H](N=C=S)C=C[C@@H](O)[C@H]1O。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the straightforward single-route solution: directly transcribe the depicted connection graph and stereochemistry into a canonical-equivalent SMILES, using the text only to know to ignore reaction arrows/transition-state notation.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecule inside the brackets: a cyclohexadiene-like six-membered carbon ring with an exocyclic methylene at the top, an isothiocyanate substituent attached through nitrogen on the upper-left stereocenter shown with a dashed bond, and two adjacent OH substituents on the right side shown as solid wedges. Ignore the curved arrows and bracket marks.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt to determine the requested output format is a SMILES expression and that all arrows in the transition-state drawing should be ignored rather than encoded.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply skeletal formula conventions, recognize the isothiocyanate group as N=C=S attached via N, encode ring closures and double bonds in SMILES, and translate the wedge/dash stereochemistry for the chosen atom traversal into [C@H]/[C@@H] descriptors.
